steps.en: OCMS runs a daily job to prepare the vehicle list for REPCCS
steps.id: OCMS menjalankan job harian untuk menyiapkan daftar kendaraan bagi REPCCS
steps.why_en: The daily job is switched off in the production settings, so it only runs when triggered by hand.
steps.why_id: Job harian dimatikan di pengaturan produksi, jadi hanya jalan kalau dipicu manual.

steps.en: OCMS selects the vehicles that are not qualified for ANS
steps.id: OCMS memilih kendaraan yang tidak qualified untuk ANS
steps.why_en: The selection window and rules differ from the check used when a notice is created.
steps.why_id: Jendela waktu dan aturan seleksi berbeda dari pengecekan saat notice dibuat.

steps.en: OCMS builds the vehicle file in the format REPCCS expects
steps.id: OCMS membuat file kendaraan dengan format yang diminta REPCCS

steps.en: The file is encrypted before it leaves OCMS
steps.id: File dienkripsi sebelum keluar dari OCMS

steps.en: The encrypted file is delivered to REPCCS
steps.why_en: Delivery code exists, but receipt by REPCCS cannot be confirmed from the code.
steps.why_id: Code pengiriman ada, tetapi penerimaan oleh REPCCS tidak bisa dipastikan dari code.
